environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4). The NLB forwards raw TCP connections to port 8080 without any request inspection. Security groups allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between client and application. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.tls_termination: on instance (nginx stream proxy, no inspection)
